notes: Idris Quillon again, told by Mirela in mirela-stacks.
text: The Court's list of teachers is very short, and the best one isn't on it. He's under the Miners' Bridge from dusk, if you can bear the damp. Buy a book first; he hates teaching people who can't read.

followUp.text: So you met him. Did you buy a book first? Good. He is insufferable to the unlettered.
